caveats: All 92 target days and all baseline-window days (1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05, including the 5 days beyond the baseline ends) were available; all 3600 regional grid cells analysed, of which 3296 were sea cells (finite SST on every target day) and 304 land cells, set to 0. Threshold 90th percentile computed with numpy method='hazen' as specified in the task; note that MATLAB's true default ('linear', Hyndman-Fan type 4) would shift the onset of the single regional event one day earlier (2009-06-23). SST compared in kelvin as stored; float64 used throughout.
